fileTab.off: Sharing is off on this Meshloom. Turn it on to send a photo as a link anyone in the conversation can open.
fileTab.hint: Drop a photo here, paste one into the message box, or choose a file.
fileTab.dropHere: Drop the photo to prepare it
fileTab.summary: {{type}}, {{before}} before, {{after}} after ({{width}} x {{height}} px). Position and camera data are removed.
fileTab.caption: Caption (optional)
fileTab.captionTooLong: The caption is too long for one message. Shorten it.
fileTab.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Check the connection and try again.

error.heic: HEIC photos (iPhone) cannot be read by this browser. Share the photo as JPEG (Settings > Camera > Formats > Most Compatible) or pick it again through the photo picker, which converts it.
error.unsupported: This file is not a photo that can be shared. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
error.tooLarge: This file is too large to share (10 MiB at most once prepared, 5 MiB for a GIF).
error.decode: This browser cannot read this image.

mode.label: Who can open the photo
mode.publicHint: Anyone with the link can open the photo.
mode.encryptedHint: Sealed for this conversation: only its members can open the photo.
mode.dmUnavailable: Encrypted photos in direct messages need the radio's key, which this Meshloom has not read yet. Only public sending is possible for now.
mode.noConversationId: This Meshloom did not give this channel a sharing id: only public sending is possible.

clear.public: The Public channel's key is known to everyone: files are published in clear.
clear.hashtag_derived: This channel's key is computed from its name: files are published in clear.
clear.room: A room server reads every post: files are published in clear.
